svg.title: Life, versioned
svg.desc: A Git-style life graph. Career, garage, photography and club branches split from a shared life spine. Dated milestones sit on their own branches, which merge back together at now. Life, versioned. One life. A few branches. life career garage photo club 2014 · Minecraft + Lua Mining turtles on my own server. 2016 · Start at Novartis Betriebsinformatiker apprenticeship. 2019 · KTM Duke 390 The garage starts on two wheels. 2020 · Finish the EFZ Four years of IT foundations. 2021 · Into full-stack PHP, Vue and business applications. 2022 · Found Jogge di Balla Co-founder and vice president. 2023 · A camera joins in Sony α7 IV. 2023 · Audi TT RS A new chapter on four wheels. 2024 · The S5 project Audi S5 B8.5. 2024 · Costa Rica, solo Wildlife through the lens. 2025 · APIs + data sync Interfaces and integrations. 2025 · The ICE, St. Moritz Cars, winter light and Koenigsegg. 2026 · Club platform live Service, kitchen and bar connected. 2026 · Publish AI toolkit Reusable skills and specialist agents. 2026 · New 20-inch wheels Polished details for the S5. now · Still in development Code, cameras, cars and club life.
